description: MetaHive is Metaguise's custom parametric facade system, built from solid 3D aluminium panels. Engineered and fabricated in-house from technical drawing to installation, it's designed for projects that demand a distinct, geometry-driven architectural identity - as seen at the Whiteland Westin Residences experience centre in Gurugram, with architecture by Hafeez Contractor. Ideal for architects seeking a bold, sculptural architectural solution.
